csv_scope_of_work: The City of Cupertino (City) invites Statement of Qualifications (SOQ) from qualified consultants to provide a comprehensive emergency on-call professional building inspection services for issued building permit applications. The City is seeking to secure a firm that has the required experience, qualifications, expertise and resources to perform the services identified in this Request for Qualifications (RFQ) The Consultant shall provide emergency on-call building inspection services on an asneeded basis for the City s Community Development Department, Building Division, functioning as an extension of City staff under the direct authority of the Building Official. In this capacity, the Consultant will perform emergency field inspections to verify that construction or work for which a permit is required complies with the Cupertino Municipal Code, the California Building Standards Code, and all applicable state and local regulations. The Consultant shall ensure that all work remains accessible and exposed for inspection purposes until approved, conducting necessary evaluations including, but not limited to, footing and foundation, concrete slab, framing, lath and gypsum, energy efficiency, and final inspections as established by the adopted codes. Following each requested inspection, the Consultant shall either indicate the portion of the construction that is satisfactory as completed or formally notify the permit holder or their authorized agent of any code deficiencies. Any portions of the work that do not comply must be clearly documented for correction, ensuring that non-compliant work is not covered or concealed until ultimately authorized and approved. The Consultant is expected to maintain a high level of professional standard and timely service, with specific projects, inspection response times, and corresponding deliverables defined in individual task orders

short_description: On-call building inspection services for permitted construction projects in Cupertino.
project_scope: Emergency on-call professional building inspection services for issued building permit applications for the City's Community Development Department, Building Division. Services include field inspections to verify compliance with the Cupertino Municipal Code, California Building Standards Code, and applicable state and local regulations. Inspection types include footing and foundation, concrete slab, framing, lath and gypsum, energy efficiency, and final inspections. The consultant documents compliance or deficiencies and ensures non-compliant work is not concealed before approval.
services: On-call building inspection services; field inspections for permitted building works; code compliance verification; inspection reporting and deficiency documentation; task-order-based support to the Building Official.
relevance_explanation:
- This is primarily an inspection services procurement, not structural design or engineering planning.
- The scope focuses on routine building code inspections for general building works.
- No bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building design component is described.
- The tender does not indicate a meaningful structural engineering design role aligned with sbp's core profile.
- Inspection-only services are generally low priority for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The procurement is for on-call inspection services across multiple permit-related tasks, not for a specific construction project. No project size, building area, or capital budget is provided, so a realistic estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No fee or budget information is stated. The notice describes an as-needed on-call services contract with up to three contracts and a 24-month base period, but provides no contract value, hourly rates, or estimated workload.
references_qualifications: Qualified consultants must demonstrate experience, qualifications, expertise, and resources to provide emergency on-call building inspection services for issued building permit applications and to act under the authority of the Building Official.
